title: Thích nghi hay giảm phát thải · Discuss both views
prompt: Some people support prioritising climate adaptation over further emissions reductions, while others oppose it because of the risks it could create. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

outline.purpose: Dạng discuss yêu cầu giải thích riêng vì sao mỗi phía tin lập trường của mình rồi đưa phán đoán của người viết. Trong bài này, cân nhắc trọng tâm là: Thích nghi giảm mức tiếp xúc với rủi ro đang xảy ra; giảm phát thải tác động nguồn gây rủi ro dài hạn. Trung tâm tránh nóng giúp ngay trong đợt nóng, khi chuyển đổi năng lượng chưa thể phát huy đầy đủ. Chỉ thích nghi có thể làm chi phí bảo vệ tăng mãi khi khí hậu tiếp tục xấu. Kết hợp hai hướng chỉ thuyết phục khi giữ nguồn lực cho bảo vệ cấp bách và nêu vì sao không được bỏ giảm phát thải.
outline.content: Supporters argue that adaptation can protect communities facing immediate climate hazards. Opponents respond that adaptation alone leaves the underlying causes of escalating risk largely untouched. Although supporters correctly emphasise immediate protection, I side with opponents of a general shift away from emissions reduction because unchecked warming makes adaptation progressively less affordable and effective.

paragraphs: Supporters argue that adaptation can protect communities facing immediate climate hazards. Opponents respond that adaptation alone leaves the underlying causes of escalating risk largely untouched. Although supporters correctly emphasise immediate protection, I side with opponents of a general shift away from emissions reduction because unchecked warming makes adaptation progressively less affordable and effective.

Adaptation can protect communities facing immediate climate hazards. Drainage, shade and emergency planning reduce exposure while wider energy transitions take time. A town could protect vulnerable residents during a heatwave by opening accessible cooling centres. Such measures address exposure to hazards already occurring, making their timing particularly important for residents who cannot wait for global emissions to fall. Cooling centres can reduce immediate exposure to heat, but their value does not remove the need to limit the warming that makes such emergencies more frequent.

Adaptation alone leaves the underlying causes of escalating risk largely untouched. Protective infrastructure addresses exposure rather than the processes increasing the hazard. If warming continues, protection may need repeated expansion or become insufficient, leaving communities committed to rising adaptation costs without reducing the source of the pressure. Urgent local protection should be combined with a credible programme of emissions reduction. A combined programme should specify what is protected now and what reduces future hazards, rather than use the language of balance to conceal inadequate funding for either. Priorities should reflect the urgency of local risks while preserving emissions cuts that reduce the scale and cost of future adaptation.

The urgency of adaptation explains its appeal, but cannot establish its general precedence over prevention; protecting people now and limiting future warming address complementary dangers rather than interchangeable spending priorities.

paragraphs.quote: Adaptation alone leaves the underlying causes of escalating risk largely untouched. Protective infrastructure addresses exposure rather than the processes increasing the hazard. If warming continues, protection may need repeated expansion or become insufficient, leaving communities committed to rising adaptation costs without reducing the source of the pressure. Urgent local protection should be combined with a credible programme of emissions reduction. A combined programme should specify what is protected now and what reduces future hazards, rather than use the language of balance to conceal inadequate funding for either. Priorities should reflect the urgency of local risks while preserving emissions cuts that reduce the scale and cost of future adaptation.

options: I completely support prioritising climate adaptation over further emissions reductions in every circumstance, regardless of its consequences.

The issue of prioritising climate adaptation over further emissions reductions is very important in modern society and has many different opinions.
